title: Move product search from SQL LIKE to Elasticsearch
description: Product search used SQL LIKE queries and took over 2 seconds on the full catalogue. We need real full-text search with relevance ranking.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Compared three options: Postgres full-text search, Elasticsearch and Algolia. Chose Elasticsearch because we need custom ranking and already run the cluster for logs.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: We rejected Algolia because per-query pricing would cost about ten times more at our traffic, and our contract requires data to stay in the EU.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: We also rejected Postgres full-text search because ranking by popularity plus stock is awkward to express and it slowed down checkout queries on the same database.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Gotcha: any mapping change needs a full reindex, which takes about 40 minutes. Always reindex into a new index and swap the alias so search never goes down.
